name: Columns Footer with Status
description: A dark product footer: a hairline link grid that draws in and lights from inside, a status pill whose dot and uptime land last, a theme switch and locale menu.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark next to the drawn mark in the first cell.

props.name: description
props.default: "Queues, cron and webhooks that retry until they land."
props.description: One line under the brand, max 30ch.

props.name: release
props.description: Release pill pinned to the bottom of the brand cell. null hides it.

props.name: columns
props.type: { title: string; links: { label; href; badge?; external? }[] }[]
props.description: Four link columns. badge renders a small mono tag; external adds ↗ and opens a new tab.

props.name: status
props.description: Status pill variant: colour, copy and breathing speed all follow it.

props.name: uptime
props.description: 90-day uptime in percent, shown in the status pill. Counts up from zero once the pill lands; null hides it.

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled value of the 3-way theme switch. Omit to let it keep its own state.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: Initial value when the switch is uncontrolled.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: The switch only reports; apply the theme yourself.

props.name: locale
props.description: Controlled locale code. Omit to let the menu keep its own state.

props.name: defaultLocale
props.description: Initial locale code when the menu is uncontrolled.

props.name: onLocaleChange
props.description: Called when a locale is chosen.

props.name: copyright
props.description: Mono line in the bottom bar.

controls.label: Tagline
controls.default: Queues, cron and webhooks that retry until they land.
